action_items: No backend tests were added: both acceptance criteria are pure client-side navigation/animation-timing concerns (mobile drawer scroll behavior) with no API-bearing behavior. Backend pytest suite collected 0 tests, as expected.

checks.criterion: Every mobile navbar section link closes the drawer and scrolls to the correct section
checks.name: mobile-nav-section-links
checks.evidence: At 390x844: for each of about/skills/deployments/projects/leetcode/contact, opened mobile-navigation-toggle drawer, clicked the nested text span inside mobile-nav-<slug>-link, verified: URL hash updated to #<slug>, mobile-navigation drawer became hidden, and the target section's bounding-box top settled between ~40-160px from viewport top (within the fixed 72px header offset tolerance). Verified once on localhost:3000 and re-confirmed against the public preview URL https://portfolio-refresh-185.preview.emergentagent.com (reran-persisted mode) - both passed.

checks.criterion: Mobile navbar taps remain accurate while the drawer is still entering
checks.name: mobile-nav-tap-during-entrance
checks.evidence: At 390x844: opened the drawer and tapped mobile-nav-contact-link as soon as it attached to the DOM (no wait for entry animation). Confirmed: (1) scrollY did not move meaningfully (<=10px) immediately after the click, (2) URL hash became #contact synchronously, proving the tapped link target was not shifted onto a neighboring link by the still-animating drawer, (3) the mobile-navigation drawer closed, (4) scrollY still had not moved meaningfully ~100ms into the exit transition (well before the component's 300ms post-close delay), (5) scrolling eventually began and carried the viewport past the About section, landing on Contact only after the deferred timer fired. Confirms scroll begins only after drawer exit completes and the correct section (not a shifted one) is targeted.
